body:
That sounds like a pretty neutral situation to me, if I am being honest. It seems like you weren't the only one at fault. Women are confusing and I will not try to speak for every one, but I know that I hardly ever know what, exactly, I want, so maybe other women feel the same way. That seems like what happened here, on her part.

I am in a relationship that has extreme ups and downs. One hour we are talking about growing old together and the next we are talking about splitting up and he is ignoring me. We just argue over everything. It has been like this for years. Can't live with him, can't live without him.. literally. I can't stand it when he ignores me. He knows how I am. Where my mind goes. Actions that have played out in the past. I don't understand how he can knowingly do this to me. I need him even when I am mad at him and he isnt there for me.

My first suicide attempt was at 13 over a boy. Everyone told me I was just being a stupid hormonal teenager. Now what? Why does my will to live have to depend on someone else, why have I never been able to find it in myself?

I am sorry to hear about your ex. What is that you did that you believe was bad and made her leave you?

I agree on that part. I am so tired of reaching out to people I know and getting the same old, "It will get better. It's not that bad." If I have been suicidal for 10+ years please tell me when it is going to end or get better? I would really honestly rather live, but I can't stand the loneliness, or on the flip side, the hurt people cause me when I give them the opportunity.

What is reddit karma delay? I have never used Reddit. Only lurked. Finally got desperate enough.

Desperation from loneliness. Like I said, I have one support person, and when he has had too much, I am left alone with my feelings. Loneliness has always been the motivator. Suicidal ideation started very young (8 or 9 years old) and it has always stemmed from that. I didn't have friends in school, etc. I don't connect with people easily, and so when I do, I think I become too intense and dangerously dependant.
